notes.title: Lines Go Level Updated!
notes.notes:
"The levels in the Lines Go Playtest have been updated! We've adjusted the pacing of introducing new mechanics, making challenges in each stage more varied — giving players more opportunities to practice and master every skill.

For the new final levels, tougher challenges await!

Note: In the current version, save progress is tied to level numbers, so some players might experience rollbacks in their unlocked stages. We’ll optimise the update logic in future patches to minimise impact on existing saves. Thanks for your patience and support!"
